Bart Ball

1 v 1 · ghost runners · night game

Pick your player
Play a friend online

Online play needs an internet connection. On claude.ai you also need to be signed in.

How to play
  • Pitching: pick Fastball, Curveball, Slider or Changeup (keys 1–4). Aim at the zone and click (or Space). A ring closes in on your target at the same speed every pitch: click again right as it touches the colored target ring. Your target drifts while the ring closes (more on breaking balls and when you're tired), so steer it back with the mouse. Early or late releases miss your spot.
  • Batting: move the swing indicator (the yellow brackets) onto the ball. The diamond on the ball sets the angle: top diamond = fly ball or pop-up, middle diamond = line drive, bottom dot = grounder. For home runs, get the ball between the top and middle diamond with perfect timing. Perfect timing plus the ball dead-center on the diamond column is a PERFECT-PERFECT (max power). and click or press Space as it reaches the plate. Swing early to pull it, late to go the other way. Get under it to lift it, over it for a grounder.
  • Short hits are singles, deep ones doubles, triples are rare, and anything over the wall is gone. Runners are ghosts that advance on their own.
  • Fielding: when you're in the field and a ball is hit to your guys, a ring closes in. Press Space when it hits the circle. Late throws let the runner beat it, bad ones sail into the stands and drops are errors.
  • The 6th hitter, Michael Fish, has a quiet, compact stance with low hands and a short, powerful swing.
  • The 9th hitter is a speed demon: he dances up to the plate in shades, can barely swing (just pokes it), but flies down the line.
  • Pitchers get tired and lose speed and control. Press B for the bullpen to bring in the Closer, the Submarine guy, the Wonky guy, or go back to your Starter.
  • Umpires: they blow some calls. Press C within 1 second of a call to challenge (2 per team; you keep it if you're right), or X to argue (careful, you can get tossed).
  • Hold V for the emote wheel.
  • Debug mode (vs bot) lets you force any result and control the bullpen.
